metric_contract.input: exact option contract (nearest heavy-theta expiry; near-ATM; need not be strict 0DTE)
metric_contract.signals: same-day underlying 1m K-line for entry/exit timing only
metric_contract.execution: trade the option contract, never the stock
metric_contract.forbidden: underlying-proxy payoff / underlying return x multiplier
enforcement: custody/offline.py: assert_paired_slice() requires underlying + option series per case
custody/marketdata.py: require_paired_bars() requires both bar streams

custody_eval.product_constraint: Custody targets same-day/0DTE and near-ATM; QQQ case is 0DTE, SKHY/BABA are 4 DTE (flag for replacement if strictly 0DTE). All three are within ~0.7% of strike.
custody_eval.price_note: Underlying and option series are 1m trade OHLCV, not NBBO. Offline quote() returns None unless the labelled option_bar_close plumbing mapping is opted in; live uses real quotes through the same provider boundary.
custody_eval.zero_dte_note: Validation custody-eval-2026-09-14 still contains two non-0DTE cases: US.SKHY260918P175000 (DTE 4) and US.BABA260918C109000 (DTE 4); only US.QQQ260914C705000 is 0DTE. Flagged for supervisor: replace the two 4-DTE legs with same-day contracts before treating the validation slice as strictly 0DTE. Left unchanged here rather than silently rewritten.
custody_eval.note: 10 distinct single-name true-0DTE (INTC+AMD+TSLA+NVDA+MU+AVGO+AMZN+GOOGL+META+MSFT). Prior custody-eval-2026-09-14 kept as secondary (includes non-0DTE SKHY/BABA).

custody_train.volume_floor_basis: two-tier auto: index floor = 10% of the pooled US.SPY/US.QQQ/US.IWM chosen-contract ATM 0DTE median day-volume (median 570485 -> 57000); single-name floor = 10% of the index floor (min 1000 -> 5000)
custody_train.contract_selection: near-ATM listed strike nearest the session first-bar underlying open that has both a CALL and PUT 1m series; the traded right is the side with the higher same-day option volume
custody_train.direction_policy: volume rule: LONG (buy CALL) when the ATM CALL day-volume >= the ATM PUT day-volume, else SHORT (buy PUT). Single names are only considered on sessions with a same-day 0DTE expiry; each symbol then has to clear its tier volume floor (index vs single-name). No scenario labels are used.
custody_train.underlying_source: eval-data-v2 klines_1m.parquet where present (window through 2026-09-11); read-only OpenD K_1M for later sessions
custody_train.role_note: formal custody train: TRUE 0DTE only (expiry == trade_date, DTE=0). No DTE 1-4 padding. Liquid index ETFs SPY/QQQ/IWM plus the Mag7-style mega-caps (AAPL/MSFT/NVDA/TSLA/META; AMZN/GOOGL only where a warm same-day expiry exists) and AMD/MU, each kept only on a same-day expiry that clears its tier volume floor. A two-tier floor keeps single names that are below SPY-sized volume but still liquid, and a SPY share cap holds the set diversified. The mixed-DTE custody-train-dte4 set is archive.
custody_train.warm_group_note: OpenD option history is quota-accounted per (underlying, expiry) group: new strikes inside an already-warm 0DTE group are recoverable, but brand-new expiry groups are refused once the 7-day quota is spent. Only warm same-day expiry groups are targeted; the resulting OpenD retention gaps are recorded in opend_gaps.
custody_train.retention_limitations: OpenD option history is quota-accounted per (underlying, expiry) group (option quota fully spent at option: 60/60; released after 7 days). Only already-warm same-day groups were recoverable: SPY 18 of 20 window sessions (missing 2026-09-10 and 2026-09-14), QQQ 2026-08-21/28 + 2026-09-04/11/14, IWM 2026-08-21 and 2026-09-11, and single names only on their warm same-day expiries (AAPL 5 sessions; MSFT/META 4; NVDA/TSLA/AMD/MU 1). AMZN and GOOGL have no warm same-day group and are recorded in unavailable_symbols. The SPY share cap then held out the 6 lowest-volume SPY sessions (recorded in spy_cap_dropped). No DTE>=1 contract is substituted for a missing 0DTE group.

eval_session.note: placeholder must-trade policy; option-bar-close fills; not an alpha

custody_train.quality_note: True 0DTE only: every case has expiry == trade_date (DTE 0), no DTE 1-4 padding. Diversified beyond the index ETFs: 36 cases across 10 underlyings, 47.2% non-ETF single names (AAPL/MSFT/META/NVDA/TSLA/AMD/MU), so the set is no longer SPY-dominated (SPY 33.3%, under the 35% cap). The two-tier volume floor keeps Mag7 below SPY-sized volume but still liquid, and the held-out SPY sessions are recorded in spy_cap_dropped. The prior custody-train-dte4 mixed-DTE set is demoted to archive. Calendar overlap with the eval-data-v2 window is not quality; the 0DTE coverage is a function of OpenD retention.
custody_train.prospective_freeze_note: Freeze each new session's same-day (0DTE) paired underlying+option 1m bars the same day, while the chain still exists, and append them to this set; OpenD drops old weeklies and the option quota blocks new expiry groups, so the 0DTE train only grows with a daily freeze.
custody_train.status: canonical formal true-0DTE paired custody train (diversified across index ETFs and Mag7 single names)

custody_train.note: True 0DTE only; index+Mag7 diversified. custody-train-dte4 is archived (mixed DTE).

custody_train_dte4_archive.demotion_reason: Mixed DTE 0-4. Non-0DTE and 0DTE trade very differently (non-0DTE fills are often poor; 0DTE volume is high and fillable). The formal train is now true-0DTE only (custody-train-0dte). This slice is retained as an archive, not cited as canonical train.

custody_train_raw_cache.underlying_source: eval-data-v2 klines_1m.parquet (reused; no OpenD underlying re-fetch)
custody_train_raw_cache.contract_selection: nearest retrievable heavy-theta expiry per session (same-day 0DTE or the next retrievable weekly; 2026-08-21 for the earliest window sessions because earlier OpenD option history is gone) with the listed strike nearest the session first-bar underlying open that has real 1m bars
custody_train_raw_cache.direction_policy: eval-data-v2 session_1m scenario labels: strong_down/v_reversal_down/gap_down -> SHORT (PUT); strong_up/v_reversal_up/gap_up -> LONG (CALL); else LONG. Labels define the case direction only, never timing features.
custody_train_raw_cache.demotion_reason: Parent raw cache for the DTE filter. The 2026-05-14..2026-09-11 calendar window overlaps eval-data-v2, but many cases are long DTE (up to 99) because OpenD lost pre-2026-08-21 weeklies; calendar overlap is not quality. Raw/parent cache only.
custody_train_raw_cache.status: raw/parent cache only; demoted from canonical train
